facts.fact: 爆炸余音：Gibbons 向 Ben 咆哮「她把房子炸了」——Clara 的战果被敌方认证。
facts.anchor: “She’s everywhere, you idiot! She’s the one that blew up the house.”

facts.fact: Ben 抱起她立誓：你是有能力的，我再也不会怀疑——平权战争在此刻落幕。
facts.anchor: You’re capable. I’ll never doubt that again.

facts.fact: Clara 的战报自夸（喘着气）+ Ben「I saw」——两人从紧张对峙滑回笑与泪。
facts.anchor: “I beat the crap out of him,” I wheeze

facts.fact: Ben 对 Quint 喊「我找到她了，她活着」——声音因释然而破。
facts.anchor: His voice cracks with relief. “I’ve got her. She’s alive.”

facts.fact: Clara 向 Quint 伸手、Ben 的手臂收紧却还是把她交出去——两个男人完成无言交接。
facts.anchor: I reach a hand out to him, desperate to be in his arms, and guilt sweeps through me

facts.fact: Quint 抱住她亲遍额颊发——订婚身份在这一刻失效。
facts.anchor: I don’t consider that Quint is still engaged when his lips press against the side of my head

facts.fact: 半昏迷中 Clara 说出口：我爱你。永远。——「永远」的告白给 Quint。
记忆加速飞散：小女孩们的画面+她「布满皱纹的手」被 Quint 握着——一条衰老记忆（老年的他们）。
facts.anchor: The memories are flying away faster now, snatching back the images of those little girls and my wrinkled hands encased in Quint’s.

facts.fact: 章末：「我不知道这意味着什么」——皱纹的手=未来某条时间线的自己？
facts.anchor: And I don’t know what that means.
